data.name: Ankaj
data.gender_notes: Ankaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ankaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anka' meaning unique and 'Ja' meaning born. This name signifies that the bearer is one-of-a-kind, exceptional and unique in every way. The name Ankaj carries the meaning “Unique, One-of-a-kind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ankaj usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, one-of-a-kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ankaj is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the uniqueness of every soul and encourages the bearer to embrace their individuality and spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Ankaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unique, One-of-a-kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ankaj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ankaj holds a significant cultural appeal in Hindu tradition, as it emphasizes the value of individuality and uniqueness. In Hindu society, each person is believed to have a unique soul, and the name serves as a reminder of this distinct identity. Moreover, the name Ankaj carries a sense of pride and self-confidence, as it highlights the bearer's one-of-a-kind status.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ankaj can be considered a reflection of the divine essence within each individual. In Hinduism, the concept of Atman (soul) and Brahman (God) is paramount. The name Ankaj embodies this principle, reminding the bearer that they are a unique manifestation of the divine, and encouraging them to explore their spiritual gifts and potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ankaj signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anka' meaning knowledge or wisdom, and 'Ji' symbolizing the embodied soul. Hence, Ankaj represents an individual who is deeply rooted in knowledge and wisdom, and strives to apply it in their daily life.
